results.name: Alternating Leg Lifts
instructions: Lie down on your back with your legs straight and hands behind your head.
Raise one of your legs straight towards the ceiling without bending your knee.
Slowly lower your leg back towards the floor and simultaneously raise the other leg.
tips: Keep your lower back pressed into the mat to maintain proper alignment and avoid strain.
Use a controlled breathing pattern: inhale as you lift your leg and exhale as you lower it.
Engage your thigh muscles to assist with the lift and maintain straight legs throughout the movement.
results.description: Alternating Leg Lifts is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back.

results.name: Alternating Oblique Sit-Ups
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Lift your shoulders off the mat and twist your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Lower your shoulders back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maximize muscle activation and protect your lower back.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift and twist your torso.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to ensure proper form and maximize effectiveness.
results.description: Alternating Oblique Sit-Ups is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Alternating Plank Lunge
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Step your right foot forward outside your right hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position.
Return your right foot to the plank position.
Step your left foot forward outside your left hand, bringing your body into a low lunge position. Return your left foot to the plank position. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper alignment.
Ensure your front knee is aligned with your ankle and does not extend past your toes to avoid strain on your knee joint.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternating Plank Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Triceps.

results.name: Alternating Toe Tap
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight on the floor and your arms resting by your sides.
Simultaneously lift your right leg and left arm towards the ceiling, trying to touch your toe with your hand.
Lower your right leg and left arm back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left leg and right arm, lifting them towards the ceiling and trying to touch your toe with your hand. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Keep your legs straight and avoid bending your knees to ensure proper form.
results.description: Alternating Toe Tap is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Shoulders.

results.name: Assisted Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet secured with a partner holding them down.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, performing a sit-up.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your body, not your momentum.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift your body.
Keep a steady breathing pattern, exhaling as you lift and inhaling as you lower your body.
results.description: Assisted Sit-Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Ball Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor and knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lean back, rolling the ball under your lower back, and place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and lift your upper body upwards until vertical to the floor.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position, repeat.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and proper form.
Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands to prevent strain; use your core muscles to lift your body.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Ball Sit-Up is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Band Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat and secure a resistance band around both feet. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward, and keep your legs extended straight.
Engage your core and lift your upper body off the floor. Bend your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Switch sides by bending your left knee towards your chest while bringing your right elbow towards your left knee, performing a pedaling motion.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid pulling on your neck with your hands; use your abs to lift and twist your torso.
Ensure the resistance band is securely placed around your feet and on the equipment to avoid slipping.
Maintain a steady rhythm and focus on controlled movements rather than speed.
results.description: Band Bicycle Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Band Decline Sit Up
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point behind the headrest of a decline bench. Lie on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads and hold one handle of the band in each hand, positioning the band over your shoulders.
Contract your abs and lift your upper body up towards your knees, bringing your chest towards your thighs until you are in a seated position.
Slowly lower your upper body down the bench, maintaining control and tension in the band until your back rests on the bench.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored behind the headrest to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you lift your upper body and inhale as you lower it back down.
Avoid pulling on the band with your arms; focus on using your abs to lift your body.
results.description: Band Decline Sit Up is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Band Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Secure the middle of the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point above head height. Kneel on the floor facing away of the anchor point, holding one handle of the band in each hand with your hands positioned at the sides of your head.
Engage your core and bend at the waist, bringing your elbows towards your knees in a controlled crunch motion.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, ensuring a full contraction of your abdominal muscles.
Slowly return to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abs to pull your torso down rather than your arms.
Ensure the resistance band is securely anchored to avoid slipping.
Exhale as you crunch down and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Band Kneeling Crunch is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Obliques, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Band Side Bend
instructions: Anchor one end of the band at a low point of the equipment. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, your right side leaning to the anchor point, holding the other end of the resistance band in your right hand. Allow your left hand to hang by your side for counterbalance.
Contract your left obliques to bend at the waist to your left side until you are upright.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Engage your core to help stabilize your body and prevent unnecessary movement.
Avoid bending forward or backward; focus on bending directly to the side.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you bend to the side and inhaling as you return to the upright position.
results.description: Band Side Bend is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Lower Back.
